name: chronic kidney disease overview
title: Chronic kidney disease decision chart: the definition and stages, then four jobs side by side: slow the decline (blood pressure targets by diabetes status, ACE inhibitor or ARB, glycemic target), prevent superimposed injury, treat the complications, and plan renal replacement early

root.title: Chronic kidney disease (CKD): is it CKD, and how do you SLOW it?
lines: kidney DAMAGE (protein or blood in the urine) or estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) < 60 · for ≥ 3 MONTHS · not on dialysis or transplant
causes: #1 diabetes · #2 hypertension · #3 glomerulonephritis · polycystic kidney disease (genetic)
after 40, GFR falls 0.7–1 mL/min a year: judge against age

groups.title: STAGE it by GFR, % of normal
lines: below ~25%: POINT OF NO RETURN, it keeps falling even once the insult is gone

head: h
2 · PREVENT a second injury
aim: Nothing ON TOP of the CKD

head: h
3 · TREAT what it causes
aim: • Na kept: heart failure, lung edema, arrhythmia

head: h
4 · PLAN renal replacement
prevents wasting (cachexia)
aim: transplant or dialysis takes time to set up
do: • AEIOU: see ACUTE KIDNEY INJURY chart
• in CKD also uremic ENCEPHALOPATHY, PERICARDITIS
